contracts.name: direct_light_count_includes_all_supported_local_lights
contracts.description: The direct-light selection domain must include every supported analytic light array.

contracts.name: direct_light_selection_pdf_is_inverse_count
contracts.description: Uniform light selection PDF must be exactly 1 / DirectLightCount().

contracts.name: sample_one_light_draws_one_selected_light
contracts.description: The shared direct-light sampler must draw one discrete light index from the direct-light count.

contracts.name: delta_lights_are_divided_by_selection_pdf
contracts.description: Delta directional/spot contributions must divide by the probability of selecting the sampled light.

contracts.name: finite_light_pdfs_include_selection_pdf
contracts.description: Area-to-solid-angle light PDFs in direct lighting must include the discrete light selection PDF.

contracts.name: emissive_hit_pdf_uses_same_selection_pdf
contracts.description: BSDF-hit emitter MIS must use the same discrete selection probability as direct lighting.

contracts.name: environment_distribution_descriptor_is_bound
contracts.description: Environment importance sampling must bind a sidecar CDF distribution buffer.

contracts.name: environment_pdf_uses_cdf_and_solid_angle
contracts.description: Environment PDF must convert the CDF texel probability to solid-angle density.

contracts.name: environment_direct_lighting_uses_mis
contracts.description: Explicit environment NEE must sample the CDF and MIS against the BSDF PDF.

contracts.name: environment_direct_mis_is_max_depth_gated
contracts.description: Direct envmap NEE must not MIS against a BSDF env-hit technique when maxDepth prevents that technique from existing.

contracts.name: environment_bsdf_miss_uses_mis
contracts.description: BSDF-sampled envmap hits must MIS against the environment PDF, excluding delta samples.

contracts.name: tube_emissive_hit_pdf_is_represented
contracts.description: Tube light geometry hits must have a matching area-to-solid-angle PDF expression.
